examples.label: Sweep all ports fast, then enumerate each service

notes:
Layer 1 Internet Presence: domains, subdomains, vHosts, ASN, netblocks, IPs, cloud, security measures
Layer 2 Gateway: firewalls, DMZ, IPS/IDS, EDR, proxies, NAC, segmentation, VPN, Cloudflare
Layer 3 Accessible Services: type, functionality, config, port, version, interface
Layer 4 Processes: PID, processed data, tasks, source, destination
Layer 5 Privileges: groups, users, permissions, restrictions, environment
Layer 6 OS Setup: OS type, patch level, network config, config files, sensitive private files

recommended.note: Start Layer 1 enumeration with passive domain recon

name: Reference - Enumeration Methodology (6 Layers)
command: # work outside-in: Internet presence -> gateway -> services -> processes -> privileges -> OS
description: HTB's layered enumeration model - a mental checklist so you enumerate systematically rather than randomly poking ports.
